title: workspace-workflow-bridge-v1: backend capture grants and native receipts
$comment: Q37 additive owner contract. Definitions below are selected by the existing endpoints, not one permissive top-level envelope. Legacy capture/role/fact definitions and child lifecycle V3 remain unchanged. Prompt-free application and parent ready identity never authorize activity. Native controller binding adoption requires the manager's native ownership decision; missing adoption fails closed.

configuration.$comment: Additive WP-211B: a saved v2 agent-kit configuration (formatVersion 2 + closed agentSetup) is valid here exactly as a v1 configuration is. The document version is disjoint (v1 forbids agentSetup, v2 requires it), so a retained v1 operation is unchanged and no migration is required.

controllerApprovedInputContext.$comment: Backend-issued from independently approved input/case/policy, before prompt admission. Caller/model text cannot mint it. Cross-field equality, current authority, exact UTF-8 byte bounds and replay joins are mandatory beyond schema.

controllerOutputLineage.$comment: Normalized from actual F2 wrapper plus root-verified retained log at current.logCursor. inputText is exact retained approved UTF-8 hashed to native inputDigest; completion times are actual stepEnded/executionSucceeded.created. Native Model.Ref providerID/id maps explicitly; absent or literal default variant only are no-op. No ancestry, invented native flags or per-part text in refs.

assistantModel.$comment: Explicit exact native providerID/id mapping, matching prepared authority. No aliases/default model; executable policy separately requires its exact operator-qualified model. Source native fixture model is not executable qualification.

controllerOutputOperation.$comment: Backend permission for one exact root readback, NOT model/paid/child authority and NOT proof that proposed lineage is observed. Domain action additionally needs actual signed readback, genuine current role, holds/plan/root checks and immutable same-request association.

nativeReadback.$comment: Exact actual F2 GET wrapper, session-controller-output.ts SHA256 7bbf709e9e8ab68267853c4e5a038a8ff4db67a923d35108f4ea382698298c12. Root validates retained event DATA and contiguous history through current.logCursor; no invented native fields.
